adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`. If it is `null`, the optional chaining makes this a no-op, so destination calendars gathered from other hosts (`teamDestinationCalendars.push(user.destinationCalendar)`) are never attached to the event and are effectively dropped.
